# Template - Technical Implementation Plan

## 1. Scope

One or two sentences: which PRD this covers, and which teams are involved in delivering it.

## 2. Foundational tasks

Work required before any requirement-specific task can start. Not tied to a single requirement — use `SETUP` as the Requirement ID.
